title: My first Mall World Dream in a long time
content: So, last night I had what I thought was the first mall world dream in a while, so I decided to write this down before I forget. Let's set the scene: I'm at work and I went to go on my lunch break, only to realize I didn't actually CLOCK OUT for lunch, so I go back in to the building (Apparently Dream World me was a part-time corporate office worker) and clock out for lunch...only to find myself in this massive parking lot that seemed to be growing every second. I had intended to go to a Little Caesar's Pizza joint that was right across the street from where my work site was. But as I tried making my way across, the parking lot seemed to grow to unrealistic proportions with each step I took to the point where it felt more like navigating a labyrinth than trying to grab a bite to eat. It was basically [SCP-3008](https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-3008) as a parking lot instead of an IKEA store. I eventually got lost...and then woke up back in reality before I could figure out my next steps. Okay, so, this dream didn't involve any actual MALLS but the infinitely expanding parking lot was quite unsettling. In your experience, have dreams about getting lost in an infinite parking lot been scarier than dreams involving actual malls? Sidenote: I'm told that dreams about getting lost is an indication you're stressed about something in real life. I wonder if there's any truth to this.
